archetypes.name: design-report-integrity
archetypes.rationale: Run ID and root-cause metadata now cross script boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design terminal failure report path from staging through compose-report. Focus on whether source-env SESSION_ID is sanitized correctly, whether Tier A and Tier B render the same effective Run ID, and whether environment verdicts survive without leaking sensitive source-env content. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: publish-preservation
archetypes.rationale: Publish failure handling now intentionally ignores a helper return.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design-publish failure paths where design-stage-terminal-state.sh emits STAGED=false. Confirm set -e cannot abort result-env recording or final-summary rendering, and verify true helper validation errors are still downgraded only as intended. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
